# v0.15

Released 2026-11-11.

## Highlights

- The daily edge build workflow was added: it builds, tests and publishes `main` to the
  Store's `latest/edge` on its own.
- Zwift is now synced from its CDN, with the Windows helpers built in Rust, replacing the
  winetricks-based install.
- The smoke and pairing tests were made reliable (frame dumps, shutdown disconnect), and the
  launcher gained a GPU graphics-profile override and an MIT/Apache-2.0 licence.
- ccache was added to the workshop to speed up Wine builds.
